story.sectionSubtitle: From high school sweethearts in 2012 to tying the knot in 2026

chapters.title: First Outing, First Sparks
chapters.subtitle: School Trip to Manesar
chapters.desc: Where it all began. Amidst high school chatter and adventurous day outings in Manesar, two lives crossed paths and an enduring spark was ignited.

chapters.title: Bus Rides & Shared Notes
chapters.subtitle: Another High School Adventure
chapters.desc: Passing notes across school bus seats, endless inside jokes, and realizing that every school trip was only memorable because we were together.

chapters.title: Farewell Smiles & Sweet Beginnings
chapters.subtitle: At a Restaurant After School Farewell
chapters.desc: Dressed in formal farewell blazers and sarees, sitting at a local restaurant laughing over memories, silently promising that school ending was only our prologue.

chapters.title: Dhaak Beats & Festivity
chapters.subtitle: Durga Puja Celebrations
chapters.desc: Under the festive glow of pandal lights, fragrant incense, and rhythmic dhaak beats, celebrating the divine warmth of autumn together.

chapters.title: Above the Clouds in Triund
chapters.subtitle: First Mountain Trek Together
chapters.desc: Conquering rocky trails, cold mountain winds, and reaching the majestic green ridge of Triund together—our very first mountain adventure.

chapters.title: Chopsticks & Korean Flavors
chapters.subtitle: First Dinner at a Korean Restaurant
chapters.desc: Experimenting with sizzling barbecue and chopsticks, laughing through clumsy bites, and discovering our shared love for diverse culinary journeys.

chapters.title: Quiet Walks & Warm Companionship
chapters.subtitle: Precious Outings & Timeless Bonds
chapters.desc: Stepping out for spontaneous peaceful walks, sharing dreams and everyday stories, and finding comfort in simply having each other nearby.

chapters.title: The Misty Parvati Valley
chapters.subtitle: Trek to Kheerganga
chapters.desc: Winding pine trails, rushing river gorges, and soothing hot springs beneath a sky full of stars in the heart of Himachal.

chapters.title: Unstoppable Laughter
chapters.subtitle: First Live Standup Comedy Show
chapters.desc: Tears of pure laughter, front-row comedy, and sharing the sheer happiness that makes every ordinary week feel extraordinary.

chapters.title: The Moon Lake of Spiti
chapters.subtitle: Expedition to Chandratal
chapters.desc: Surrounded by barren Himalayan peaks and crystal turquoise waters at 14,000 feet, feeling that our love could weather any terrain.

chapters.title: Colors of Eternal Joy
chapters.subtitle: Festive Rang & Gulal
chapters.desc: Drenched in crimson, gold, and joy. Celebrating Holi with hearts as vibrant as the festive gulal in the air.

chapters.title: Dressed to Slay Together
chapters.subtitle: Celebrations at a Wedding
chapters.desc: All dolled up in ethnic finery, lighting up the celebration, and exchanging knowing smiles when friends asked: 'When is yours?'

chapters.title: Another Wedding, Waiting for Ours
chapters.subtitle: Dreaming of the Mandap
chapters.desc: Celebrating love with loved ones, sharing secret glances across the wedding canopy, knowing with every heartbeat that our turn was coming next.

chapters.title: Rokafied & Blessed
chapters.subtitle: Official Family Sealing of Forever
chapters.desc: Phulam Gamosas, Maithili Paag, golden envelopes, and blessed smiles. The moment both families officially proclaimed: It's #pooshu time!

chapters.title: #pooshu Forever: The Wedding
chapters.subtitle: December 2, 2026 • Sacred Vows
chapters.desc: Fourteen unforgettable years of laughter, growth, and companionship culminating at the sacred wedding mandap. Our forever starts today.

bridePage.title: Pooja Haloi
bridePage.subtitle: A journey of grace, warmth, cultural pride, and boundless dreams
bridePage.motto: 🌸 হেঁপাহৰ ৰঙীন সপোন (Dreams woven with pure devotion)
bridePage.heritageText: Rooted in the timeless elegance of Assam, Pooja carries forward the warmth of Phulam Gamosa, the pride of Muga silk, and the auspicious fragrance of Kopou orchids. Her heritage shines through festive Rongali Bihu rhythms, the reverence of Brass Xorai, and heartfelt wedding customs including Joron and Biya Naam.
bridePage.storyText: What started across high school benches in 2012 was simple and effortless. Over 14 years of exams, college, career dreams, and quiet moments, Shubham became my anchor, my confidant, and my greatest source of joy. Every milestone felt lighter with him by my side.

facts.title: The Creative Heart
facts.desc: An eye for aesthetic design, home warmth, and making every moment memorable.

facts.title: Chai Over Everything
facts.desc: Cannot start the morning without a steaming cup of handcrafted milk tea.

facts.title: Culinary Pride
facts.desc: Loves authentic Assamese Maasor Tenga, Khar, and festive homemade Pithas.

facts.title: Favorite Memory
facts.desc: Shubham surprising her after long exam seasons with comfort food and endless laughter.

bridePage.familyText: Beloved daughter of Dr. Ajit Kumar Haloi & Smt. Champa Haloi • Sister of Neha Haloi.
bridePage.blessing: May Lord Ganesha and the sacred soil of Kamrup bless their lifelong union with boundless joy and health.

groomPage.title: Shubham Thakur
groomPage.subtitle: A mind driven by vision, a heart & anchored in tradition & Love
groomPage.motto: 🦚 मिथिलाक पाग, विद्या ओ संस्कार (Honor, wisdom & sanctity)
groomPage.heritageText: Carrying the legacy of Mithila—the land of Raja Janak and Sita—Shubham takes pride in the honor of the Paag, the cosmic harmony of Kohbar art, and sacred Vedic traditions. His cultural roots represent unwavering integrity, deep respect for elders, and the musical poetry of Maithili Vivah Geet.
groomPage.storyText: The moment I saw Pooja in 2012, my world found its center. Through 14 transformative years—school farewells, engineering challenges, product milestones—her faith in me has been my guiding light. Choosing her forever is the easiest and greatest decision of my life.

facts.title: The Visionary Builder
facts.desc: Passionate technologist and product creator who loves turning complex ideas into magic.

facts.title: Melody Explorer
facts.desc: Deeply moved by traditional ghazals, regional wedding geet, and vintage melodies.

facts.title: Comfort Food
facts.desc: Classic Maithili Machh-Bhaat and festive winter tilkuts.

facts.title: Favorite Trait in Pooja
facts.desc: Her radiant smile that instantly dissolves stress and makes any house feel like home.

groomPage.familyText: Beloved son of Shri Suman Thakur & Smt. Kiran Thakur • Brother of Shivam Thakur.
groomPage.blessing: May the divine blessings of Lord Shiva and Mata Parvati grant their journey everlasting companionship.
